summary: dellemc.openmanage 13.6.0 known issues: ome_smart_fabric_info qualification pending for 2.19, idrac_diagnostics no SOCKS proxy, idrac_license ignores proxy on import, idrac_os_deployment reports success with outdated dates, PatrolReadRatePercent unsettable on iDRAC10, SCP revert doesn't remove new users, and read-only redfish volume properties.
questions: Why are proxy settings ignored when importing an iDRAC license?
Can I set PatrolReadRatePercent on iDRAC10?
Why doesn't reverting a server config profile remove new users?

answer_card.title: dellemc.openmanage known issues (13.6.0)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `ome_smart_fabric_info`: formal ansible-core 2.19 qualification pending.
- `idrac_diagnostics`: no export to HTTP/HTTPS via SOCKS proxy.
- `idrac_license`: proxy parameters ignored on import; error messages differ between iDRAC9 and iDRAC10 for invalid share names.
- `idrac_os_deployment`: returns 200 and completes even with an outdated Expose duration date.
- `idrac_redfish_storage_controller`: `PatrolReadRatePercent` can't be set on iDRAC10.
- `idrac_server_config_profile`: reverting with an older SCP completes with errors if a user was added after export (the new user isn't removed).
- `ome_smart_fabric_uplink`: same-name uplinks modify the existing one.
- `redfish_storage_volume`: encryption type and `block_io_size_bytes` are read-only on iDRAC9/10 and ignored.
